turns.doctor_opening: Hello, what brings you in today? Could you tell me about yourself and what's been going on?
turns.patient_opening: “Doctor, I’m a 47-year-old man, and I’ve developed a rash on the upper part of my back that started last night. I’m very concerned because I can’t think of any new exposures like detergents or plants, and I’ve also noticed a new cough and some mouth/mucosal soreness.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed any involuntary movements recently—like twitching, jerking, shaking, or sudden movements that you can’t control? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any twitching, jerking, shaking, or any involuntary movements or sudden uncontrolled movements.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** and feels like it **moves or shifts** when you touch it? (Yes or no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, I haven’t noticed any lump in my right breast, and I haven’t had anything that feels like it moves or shifts when I touch it.”

turns.doctor_question: When you press or gently tap around your belly button area, does it feel tender or painful? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “No, when I press or gently tap around my belly button area, it doesn’t feel tender or painful.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been vomiting recently (yes or no)?
Have you noticed a lump or mass in your **right breast** (for example, a new or growing area you can feel)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any lump or mass in my right breast, and I don’t feel anything new or growing there.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed that the lenses in **both** of your eyes look **cloudy or hazy**, making your vision seem less clear? (Yes/No)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed my vision being cloudy or hazy, and my eyes don’t seem less clear than usual.”

turns.doctor_question: In the past few months, have you lost weight without trying (for example, your clothes feel looser or the scale has gone down even though you didn’t change your diet or exercise)?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I haven’t lost weight without trying—I don’t feel like my clothes are looser or that my scale has dropped since I didn’t change my diet or exercise.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a **lump or mass in your right breast that doesn’t hurt** (painless), even if it’s small or you only feel it when you press?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, no—I haven’t noticed any lump or mass in my right breast that feels painless, even when I press to check.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you been pregnant, or is there any chance you could be pregnant right now?
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, I’m a 47-year-old man, so there’s no chance I could be pregnant.”

turns.doctor_question: Have you noticed a breast lump or swelling that seems to **move or shift** when you touch it, rather than staying fixed in one spot?
turns.patient_answer: “No, doctor—I haven’t noticed any lump or swelling in my right breast, and nothing that feels like it moves or shifts when I touch it.”

turns.doctor_question: Do you find yourself avoiding using your right knee because it hurts? (yes/no)
turns.patient_answer: “Doctor, yes—I've been avoiding using my right knee because it hurts, as part of my arthritis management.”
